Khan Curry Hut is seeking an experienced and passionate Full Time Chef to join our busy 
and growing team in Geelong. This is a full-time position offering a competitive salary and 
long-term career opportunities for the right candidate. 

Key Duties and Responsibilities 
•	Prepare, cook, and present a wide variety of authentic Indian, Pakistani, and Nepalese 
curries, ensuring traditional recipes, flavours and cooking techniques are maintained. 
•	Specialise in the preparation of regional curry dishes, including butter chicken, chicken 
tikka masala, rogan josh, karahi, korma, vindaloo, madras, jalfrezi, biryani, nihari, 
haleem, saag, dal, momo curry, goat curry, and other traditional specialties.

kebabs, tikka, seekh kebabs, and other traditional Indian specialties. 
•	Prepare and blend traditional spice mixes (masalas), marinades, curry bases, and 
sauces using authentic ingredients and cooking methods. 
•	Regulate temperatures of tandoor ovens, stoves, grills, ovens, and other cooking 
equipment to achieve consistent cooking quality. 
•	Develop, plan, and update menus by introducing new regional Indian, Pakistani, and 
•	Nepalese dishes, seasonal specials, and chef's recommendations. 
•	Standardise recipes and portion sizes to ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and 
food cost control. 
•	Estimate food and labour costs and assist in managing kitchen budgets and operational 
expenses. 
•	Monitor the quality of food throughout preparation, cooking, and presentation to ensure 
high standards are consistently maintained. 
•	Ensure curries, gravies, sauces, and accompaniments are prepared fresh daily and 
meet established quality standards. 
•	Supervise, train, and coordinate kitchen staff in authentic curry preparation techniques, 
food presentation, and safe kitchen practices. 
•	Delegate kitchen tasks effectively to ensure smooth and efficient operations during busy 
service periods. 
•	Maintain high standards of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace health and 
safety (WHS/OH&S) compliance. 
•	Inspect raw ingredients for freshness and quality before preparation and reject 
substandard products. 
•	Manage stock levels, order supplies, monitor inventory, and liaise with suppliers to 
ensure the availability of quality spices, meats, vegetables, and specialty ingredients. 
•	Minimise food waste through effective stock rotation, portion control, and inventory 
management. 
•	Collaborate with restaurant management on menu planning, food costing, pricing 
strategies, and kitchen operations. 
•	Cater for customer dietary requirements and preferences, including vegetarian, vegan, 
halal, gluten-free, and mild or extra-spicy curry options where appropriate. 
•	Plate and garnish dishes to ensure they meet the restaurant's presentation standards 
before service. 
•	Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient kitchen, ensuring proper storage, handling, 
and labelling of food in accordance with food safety regulations. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and make improvements to recipes and menu offerings to 
enhance customer satisfaction. 
•	Assist in developing and implementing standard operating procedures to improve 
kitchen productivity and maintain consistent food quality. 

Qualification and Experience:  
•	Possess excellent relevant post-secondary hospitality (cooking) qualifications, to at least 
Diploma level.  
•	Have at least three years of professional experience or more preferred in tandoor.  
•	Are available across the working week including weekends and Public Holidays.  
•	Strong knowledge of Indian cuisine, cooking techniques, and kitchen management.  
•	Offer proven ability to prioritise, set goals and have the determination to achieve them.  
•	Possess a thorough understanding of food safety and HACCP.  
•	Understand cost control, time management, prioritization, and cost-efficient procurement 
practices.  
•	Cooking tandoor dishes skills is an advantage.  
•	Passion for food and commitment to high standards of quality and hygiene.  
•	Strict compliance towards food safety
